Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Semiflush-Mount Ceiling Light with Clear Glass Shade, 10.5"H, Oil-Rubbed Bronze
Colors: Oil-rubbed Bronze
Materials: Glass
This stunning semiflush-mount ceiling light brings a vintage feeling to any living space. The clear glass shade is perfect for highlighting vintage Edison or designer bulbs - the choice is yours! 12"W x 12"D x 10.5"H Clear glass shade with a metal base in an oil-rubbed bronze finish With classic flair, this flush light is ideal for any room in your home. 2 60-watt E26 bulbs required; bulbs not included Expert installation required For indoor use only
